comment_regular: Verified `TogglePathGrid` action: flips g_PathGridDebugRenderingEnabled, updates the shared debug root, then rebuilds or clears the PathGrid visuals for the current interior grid or every loaded exterior grid cell. It is reached by ScriptCommand_TogglePathGrid. Fallout comparison: Script::ToggleNavMeshFunction (Fallout 0x823CED68) handles selectable draw modes, cover/connection overlays and transparency, and adds per-cell navmesh draws; Oblivion exposes one PathGrid display toggle and updates loaded PathGrid roots. This is a directly observed subsystem divergence.
